description:
About us

 

Hanover is an award-winning communications consultancy that advises enterprises, institutions, and individuals on building recognition and enhancing reputation.

From our offices across Europe and the Middle East, we adopt an integrated approach that connects the dots across channels, audiences and issues.

Our collective of smart, curious people think differently and live by a shared mission, purpose, vision, and values. These shape how we work, not just with our colleagues, but with clients and partners too.

Our mission is to ‘rewire communications for impact’ and harness its transformative power to advocate, trailblaze and make a difference.

We do this by igniting and empowering the potential of every individual within our company, recognising that each person is a unique spark, capable of creating extraordinary impact. We believe that by nurturing and harnessing the collective brilliance of our people, we can drive innovation, foster an uncommon work culture, and make a positive difference to society.

Embracing the complete range of skills and services across the communications spectrum without constraint, we create the best outcomes for our clients and deliver world-class work.

We're in search of a driven professional to take on the role of Account Director (or Senior Account Director for the right candidate) in our Healthcare Communications team.

You will play a pivotal role in delivering strategic guidance to our esteemed public relations clientele, overseeing account management, team leadership, and budgeting. The role involves spearheading new business initiatives, from identifying prospects to leading pitches, and nurturing the professional growth of junior team members up to the Consultant level.

Passionate about propelling innovative healthcare products, services, and organisations to new heights of success, you will engage with a varied client portfolio, ranging from leading global healthcare corporations to dynamic startups, all while making a meaningful impact on patient care and the healthcare community. Our client roster boasts prominent names like Lilly, AstraZeneca and Merck..

Joining our team means bringing your expertise to a diverse array of projects, spanning product PR, patient advocacy, corporate communications, and media relations, within stimulating therapeutic fields such as neuroscience, immunology, and cardiometabolic health.

Our team's excellence hasn't gone unnoticed—we've earned accolades from PRWeek, SABRE, and PharmaTimes, and we've been contenders for an agency award at the Communiqué Awards. Join us and be part of a team that's not just winning awards, but also making a real difference in healthcare communications.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide timely and relevant strategic advice to clients informed by broad intelligence-gathering on client, sector and competitors and policy environment
  • Project manage and supervise the delivery of all client services across multiple accounts
  • Exhibit a willingness to challenge the status quo, innovate, and embrace new ideas to drive the business forward
  • Lead regular client meetings and internal account management meetings, reviewing progress and allocating tasks
  • Manage account teams, providing direction and support to ensure high-quality client service
  • Manage client budgets and adhere to company budget setting and management processes
  • Ensure timely and accurate billing to ensure client needs are met within budget
  • Project manage activities focused on new business development, including marketing and new business pipeline management
  • Demonstrate an active and ever-expanding new business network that can provide significant opportunities for Hanover
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell services between Hanover teams and/or offices
  • Provide personal management and mentoring of junior members of the team, up to Consultant level, providing guidance to improve quality of work, overall efficiency and foster a culture of excellence
  • Conduct performance reviews and support career progression for team members
  • Champion diversity and inclusion within the team and in client work, ensuring a range of perspectives are considered and valued.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Proven track record of experience working in a healthcare / pharmaceutical PR role, ideally within a consultancy or in-house team
  • Proven media relations expertise with network of UK or international media connections
  • Proficient in both healthcare product and corporate communications
  • A willingness to challenge the status quo, innovate, and embrace new ideas to drive the business forward
  • Ability to lead teams and drive client accounts
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
  • Effective time, project and financial management
  • Client focused with close attention to detail
  • Familiarity with relevant media (print, broadcast and digital) and digital communication channels
  • Proactive and experienced in developing new business

 

BENEFITS:

In addition to a competitive salary, your core benefits package will include:

  • An annual performance-related bonus plus additional bonus potential linked to recruitment, new business and long service
  • 25 days’ annual leave (plus bank holidays)
  • Private healthcare and dental insurance
  • Travel insurance
  • A company pension plan, including 5% employer contribution

You’ll also have access to a wide range of opportunities and initiatives, including:

  • Flexible working policies, plus eligibility to apply for a sabbatical after 2 years’ service
  • Summer Fridays finish (3pm) – early Friday finish the rest of the year (4pm)
  • The Hanover Academy, which incorporates training, coaching, mentoring and reverse-mentoring opportunities to support personal development and career progression across all levels, with a generous training budget
  • International secondments as well as the opportunity to collaborate with all offices across the AVENIR GLOBAL’s network
  • A wellbeing programme, featuring (but not limited to) pre- and post-maternity leave coaching, a working parents’ group, subsidised gym membership
  • Our Culture Club, with a robust social calendar all year round and CSR activity

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement + 

 

Hanover Communications is an equal opportunities employer, committed to creating and ensuring a fair, inclusive, and diverse work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We believe that equality and diversity are essential to high performance and a thriving culture.

We maintain a strict no-tolerance stance against any form of discrimination and harassment, ensuring all individuals are treated equitably, irrespective of their race, ethnicity, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital or pregnancy status, genetic background, or any other attribute safeguarded under our company policies or federal, state or local laws and legislation.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please send an email to

We are committed to transparency about how we collect and use your data, including ensuring we comply with legal obligations relating to data protection. You can view our data privacy policy here. 

Hanover is part of AVENIR GLOBAL’s powerhouse of specialist communications consultancies across EMEA and North America. Collectively we rank among the top 15 largest communication firms in the world.

description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

🌟 About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team is crucial in providing independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely and ensure that the models we use deliver good outcomes for our customers. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) to join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across our suite of credit models, covering critical business disciplines such as credit strategy and impairment.

You’ll have a particular focus on models used for customer-level decisioning and defining our credit strategies - such as underwriting scorecards, origination PD models and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models - across all our lending products.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is deep expertise in credit risk modelling. You’ll have hands-on experience in either model validation or model development within a financial services environment, including practical experience using Python to develop, validate or analyse machine learning and statistical models. . In-depth knowledge of credit decisioning models would be a strong plus. 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading hands-on independent validation of models used for credit decisioning within our Borrowing strategies - covering a range of machine learning, decision science and NPV models. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected
  • Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models
  • Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities
  • Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
  • Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions
  • Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve
  • Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
  • Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation

Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?

The role

You’ll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of sponsors across our international conferences, building long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and driving sponsorship revenue.

This is a high-performance B2B sales role with a strong focus on sponsor retention, renewals and account growth, alongside identifying and closing new sponsorship opportunities.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys building strong client relationships, growing accounts and consistently delivering against revenue targets.

You should have:

  • At least 2 years of B2B sales experience.

  • A proven track record of achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.

  • Experience managing client relationships, retaining customers and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

  • Confidence engaging, pitching and negotiating with senior decision-makers.

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify new revenue opportunities.

  • Ambition, resilience and ownership – you take responsibility for your portfolio, performance and results.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

This role might not be the right fit if...

  • You prefer a role focused purely on relationship management, without responsibility for sales and revenue.

  • You don't enjoy negotiating, closing deals and working towards commercial targets.

  • You're not comfortable taking ownership of client relationships and proactively identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

  • You're looking for a hybrid or remote position – our London team works together from the office five days a week.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and retain sponsors: Build strong, long-term relationships with an existing portfolio of sponsors, driving renewals and repeat business.

  • Grow existing accounts: Identify opportunities to upsell, cross-sell and increase sponsorship revenue within your portfolio.

  • Drive new business: Identify, pitch and close new sponsorship opportunities to expand our client base.

  • Own your revenue targets: Take responsibility for achieving ambitious individual sales and retention targets.

  • Deliver exceptional partnerships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure sponsors receive a high-quality experience and see value in their partnerships.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and market-leading OTE.

  • Significant ownership and responsibility from day one.

  • The opportunity to work closely with our senior leadership team.

  • International travel to our conferences.

  • Training, coaching and ongoing development.

  • Strong opportunities for internal progression as we continue to grow.

About us

SetSales is a leading Northern European sales community connecting sales leaders, commercial executives and ambitious professionals. Through our conferences and events, we bring together decision-makers from across industries to share insights, build networks and explore the future of sales.

SetSales is part of United Media, a global B2B media and conferences group.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Communications Manager to lead our team in Germany, as Head of Change.org, Germany. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. The job also involves being the public voice of Change.org in the German media. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through an exceptional network, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks into how the team works. Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers. Be our voice. Act as Change.org's external spokesperson in Germany on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations. Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team. Lead with AI. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter. What you bring A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks. Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts. A strong network. You have trusted relationships with German journalists, editors and producers (ideally including key decision makers), and connections in politics and civil society across the whole democratic political spectrum, including conservative circles. You can use your contacts to place stories. Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You set priorities, give direct feedback and bring out the best in people. At a Senior Manager level, you would move resources as the news and priorities shift. Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are an experienced, media-trained spokesperson on live TV and radio and in front of senior stakeholders, and you handle tough interviews, crisis moments and politically sensitive questions with ease. AI First: You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along. Target experience 5-8+ years in communications, campaigning, political communications, a newsroom or an agency. 3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team. A proven track record of national campaigns in Germany that created significant public attention and media coverage. Experience as an organisation's spokesperson in national broadcast and / or print media. Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work. Native-level German (C2) and professional English. Interested? Great! Here's what you should know This role is based in Berlin. It is a full-time hybrid role, and we expect you to be in the Berlin office 2-3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely for the rest of the week. Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is €95,500 in Berlin. We are also open to candidates at the Manager level and the annual salary in Berlin is €83,500. We recognise that people assess their qualifications differently, and you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe you could be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 💰 Our Finance team The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management. We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently. As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin, our COO. ✨ Why this role is special You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place. You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage. You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown. You sit at the table where the decisions are made. You partner directly with the COO and the co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, and business line priorities, with the numbers you built as the basis of the discussion. 🎯 What you will do This is a builder role. We are looking for a finance leader who runs the core of Finance hands-on today and builds the team that will run it tomorrow. Over the next two years, your mandate is to recruit the people the function is missing, set up the three poles, and put in place the processes that let you step back from the day-to-day. We prefer to say it upfront: if what excites you is leading a team that already exists, this is not the role. If you want to build one on solid foundations and grow with it, it is a great one. Your responsibilities will include: Build and lead the Finance team: manage and develop the current 2 team, recruit the next hires across FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, and set how the team works; Own planning and reporting: budget, forecast, and actuals vs. budget across all business lines (Online, Card-Linked, Gift Cards) and geographies. Our modeling combines elasticity-based CAC projections, cohort-based revenue models, and granular bottom-up cost budgets — you will own it, keep improving it. Run the accounting close and controls: monthly and annual closing with our external accountants across France, Spain, and the US, the audit of our financial statements, and robust controls to prevent fraud and errors. Build toward group consolidation under international standards (IFRS) as entities are added; Manage cash and financing: day-to-day cash visibility, Gift Cards working capital, multi-currency flows, and our relationships with banks and financing partners. Cash is king — make sure the whole company knows it; Structure a multi-entity group: how our entities are organized, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, cost allocation, and local compliance as we open new countries; Be the financial voice at the leadership table: partner with the COO and co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, pricing, and business line priorities; Support investor relations: investor model, financial reporting, and fundraising preparation; Drive cost efficiency: work with budget owners on their targets and negotiate key supplier contracts; Do the work, with AI: you will be a high-level individual contributor as much as a manager. We expect you to use AI to automate repetitive work (reporting, reconciliation, data extraction) and augment analysis, so a lean team operates like a much larger one; Coordinate with external partners: accountants, auditors, and financial advisors. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: You have 10+ years of experience combining traditional finance (audit, transaction services, corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity) and finance in a high-growth tech company or scale-up. Ideally, you have done several cycles in companies at a stage close to ours. Breadth: You have worked hands-on on at least two of the three pillars of a finance function: FP&A and business projection, accounting / financial control / cash, and financing / structuring / procurement. You are a 360 finance profile, not a specialist of one area. Ownership: You have run a finance function, or a large part of one, end to end, and you have led or coordinated a team. You are ready to build a bigger one. Team builder: You have hired and developed finance people yourself, and you know what good looks like when you interview for FP&A, accounting, or procurement profiles. Hands-on builder: You are eager to build things yourself — models, closing processes, reporting packs — not only review them, and you have the drive to put in the work during the build phase. Learning speed: You understand a new business fast, and you can explain its key mechanics clearly to demanding stakeholders, including co-founders and investors. Strategic mindset: You think like a business partner, not just a finance controller, and you are comfortable challenging leadership with data-backed recommendations. Operational rigor: You are structured, data-driven, and detail-oriented, with a talent for spotting flaws and building processes that prevent them. AI-native mindset: You use AI tools in your work today and have a practical point of view on how they change the finance function. Languages: You are fluent in English (the main language we use internally). French is a plus but not mandatory 🤝 Our hiring process 20-min call with the Hiring Manager 45-min personality interview with two team members A case study followed by a 45-min debrief 45-min Founders interview Reference calls You might also be invited to meet other team members at the office for a coffee or a drink! 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. description: À propos de Galénic Fondée en 1978 par Pierre Fabre, Galénic est une Maison française de skincare scientifique qui associe excellence de la recherche, innovation et savoir-faire du luxe français. Portée par son centre d'innovation scientifique à Toulouse et par l'ouverture de la Maison Galénic Paris, à quelques pas de la Place Vendôme, la marque entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement. Notre ambition est de construire un modèle de distribution sélectif, international et omnicanal, conjuguant e-commerce, retail expérientiel, distributeurs premium et partenariats stratégiques. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous recrutons notre futur Head of Sales & Retail– Europe & International. Votre mission Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Générale, vous aurez la responsabilité de construire, piloter et accélérer le développement commercial de Galénic en Europe et sur ses marchés internationaux prioritaires. Vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale, de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires et de la rentabilité de nos différents canaux de distribution. Vous interviendrez à la fois sur la définition des stratégies commerciales, leur exécution opérationnelle et la structuration progressive des équipes. Votre objectif : transformer l'ambition internationale de Galénic en un business durable, rentable et scalable. Vos responsabilités Piloter la stratégie et la performance commerciale Construire et déployer la stratégie commerciale à trois ans, en cohérence avec les ambitions de la marque. Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, de rentabilité et de développement pour chaque canal. Piloter les budgets commerciaux, business plans, forecasts et P&L par canal. Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés : Net Sales, marge, productivité, conversion, sell-in et sell-out. Identifier les opportunités de croissance et optimiser les investissements commerciaux. 2. Accélérer le développement du e-commerce DTC Piloter la performance commerciale du e-commerce en collaboration avec les équipes Digital et Marketing. Développer le chiffre d'affaires, le taux de conversion, le panier moyen et la fidélisation client. Suivre la rentabilité du canal, les coûts d'acquisition et la contribution commerciale des investissements marketing. Développer une approche commerciale fondée sur la connaissance client, les données et la performance. 3. Développer la performance de la Maison Galénic Paris Accompagner le développement commercial de notre Maison, véritable flagship expérientiel de la marque. Piloter les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des soins et des ventes retail. Optimiser les réservations, le taux d'occupation des cabines, la conversion post-soin et la productivité commerciale. Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client. 4. Construire et développer notre réseau de distribution international Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires Identifier, sélectionner et négocier avec les distributeurs et partenaires locaux. Construire les business plans par marché : objectifs commerciaux, conditions de distribution, investissements, marges et rentabilité. Piloter les relations avec les partenaires, leurs engagements commerciaux et leurs performances. Accompagner les lancements et le développement progressif de nouveaux marchés. 5. Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client. OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques. Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA). Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca. Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One. Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants. Requirements Profil indispensable Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue. SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE. Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels. Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu. Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta. Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture. Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire. Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale). Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe. Atouts Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée). Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python. Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels. Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA. Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers). Évolution et ce que Brixio offre Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio. Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps). Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge. Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international. Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans. Processus de recrutement Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA). description: Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen. Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht. Über Dukers Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen. Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen. Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt. Deine Rolle Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson. Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online. Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig. Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit. Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein. Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt. Womit du arbeitest Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Führerausweis Kategorie B Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt. Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung. Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan. Was dich bei Dukers erwartet Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest. description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

€93.500—€126.500 EUR

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

  • Own UX strategy for our EU programme end to end, with real judgement over what to prioritise and how, as the market and the team's shape itself still takes form
  • Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data on the ground locally, including wider teams and client-side engineers,bringing user needs into decisions from the start, not added on afterward
  • Use our established research methods to bring real insight into your own design work, and feed what you learn locally back into the wider team's shared understanding
  • Lead and grow two designers based in London, building one genuinely connected team across EU and the UK from early on
  • Shape how local work becomes part of our shared platform and design system, so what you build here compounds for every client after, not just this one
  • Build directly in code where useful, using AI-assisted tools to prototype or ship small front-end changes yourself, closing the gap between design and delivery
  • Go beyond representing UX, be an active voice in the trade-offs between PMs and Design, holding the right balance between client-specific needs and our global approach, including directly with clients and stakeholders in workshops, showcases, and pre-sales conversations across the EU market
  • Help define what design leadership looks like across a genuinely distributed function, UK, EU, and Australia, while it's still being built

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record owning UX strategy and delivery end to end for a complex, multi-stakeholder product, ideally in a regulated or operationally complex industry
  • Experience designing in B2B or B2B2C environments, for professional, repeat users rather than casual consumers
  • Direct experience managing or mentoring other designers, comfortable leading a small team while still doing hands-on design work yourself
  • Experience working from, and contributing back to, a shared platform or design system, not just consuming one

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

description: Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research About Panteia Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations. Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States. Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments. As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence. The role To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence. This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy. The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners. Key responsibilities Project delivery & leadership Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements. Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination. Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners. Team & quality leadership Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners). Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables. Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes. Role in acquisition & transition The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals: Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals. Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage. Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution. Position in the organisation Reports to: Team manager. Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners. Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility. Practicalities Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week) – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations. Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset. Start date: As soon as possible. Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks. Why join Panteia? Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience. Combine analytical depth with real policy impact. Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets. Work in a compact, expert-driven team. Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered. Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials. Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc. What Panteia is looking for: 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting. Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment. Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis. Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills. Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes. Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus. MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field. Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed. description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

As a Professional Services Technical Consultant, you will play a technical role in the architecture and successful installation, integration, and deployment of Identity and Access solutions in our clients' environments. You will also assist our implementation partners in that process. You will report to the Director of Professional Services.

You will:

  • Deliver technical consulting to our customers and partners from various industries including financial services, manufacturing, government, utilities, and more. 
  • Evaluate client business, process, systems, and technology requirements and advise clients on best practices to help guide and solidify proposed designs.
  • Consult with clients to assess current problem states, establish desired future states, and make solution recommendations.
  • Participate in the detailed solution design, implementation, and delivery of Ping Identity IAM product solutions to our clients.
  • Work with customers to install, deploy, and configure Ping Identity solutions to meet the customer's requirements.
  • Collaborate with Ping Internal teams on escalated customer issues requiring deployment expertise. 
  • Participate in services pre-sales processes including presentation of effort size, best practices, and feasibility studies.
  • Develop materials for providing technical consulting (e.g., best practices, report templates, delivery guides, knowledge base articles).
  • Help partners ensure they design an architecture aligned to Ping best practices for a successful customer deployment.
  • Mentor and assist in the development of internal and external technical resources.
  • Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, production readiness, and handover, coordinating dependencies and surfacing delivery risks early.
  • Design and validate secure, scalable, highly available IAM deployments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including integration, operational, and disaster-recovery considerations.
  • Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues by analysing logs, traces, configurations, and network behaviour; work with Support and Product Engineering to drive resolution where needed.
  • Define and execute technical validation activities, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing, and support cutover and go-live planning.
  • Produce clear implementation documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials so customer and partner teams can operate and support the solution after delivery.
  • Balance strong security controls with a seamless user experience when shaping identity journeys and recommendations.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience working in a consulting capacity with a minimum of 2 years working directly in the Identity and Access Management space within a large organization or enterprise
  • Background in a consulting capacity within the Identity and Access Management space, including practical System Integration and Implementation experience 
  • A capability-maturity approach to IAM deployments
  • Comfortable with subjects such as TCP/IP networking, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, and Data Stores
  • Experience with Java/JavaScript/Groovy, HTML/CSS to support web application development
  • Experience in effort estimates and sizing of projects
  • Self-motivated, willing to take initiative, organized, able to work unaccompanied, and manage communications appropriately
  • Bachelor of Science in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Information Systems) or equivalent work-related level of experience
  • Availability to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Outstanding cross-functional cooperation skills in particular with our Go-To-Market units.
  • Excellent communication, both verbal and written
  • Practical experience integrating IAM platforms with enterprise directories, applications, APIs, and identity systems, including federation, authentication, and user lifecycle or provisioning flows.
  • Experience with identity standards and protocols such as SCIM, HTTP/REST APIs, and common directory and federation patterns, in addition to OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, FIDO and LDAP.
  • Experience designing or delivering IAM solutions in cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments, including deployment, upgrade, resilience, and operational support considerations.
  • Strong diagnostic skills across application, identity, and network layers, with experience using logs and traces to isolate and resolve integration issues.
  • Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations.
  • Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes.
  • Experience working within structured delivery practices, including managing technical risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes across a customer engagement.

You have an advantage if: 

  • Computer and Software Security certifications 
  • ForgeRock or Ping training badges/certifications 
  • Skills with DevOps best practices, including deployment automation tools, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes 
  • Experience with Ping Identity products and architectures, such as PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, PingOne, or PingID.
  • Experience with identity governance, privileged access, customer identity, or workforce identity use cases beyond a single IAM product or deployment pattern.
  • Familiarity with observability and operational tooling, such as centralised logging, monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing.
  • Experience with source control, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and automated testing for repeatable IAM deployments.
  • Experience migrating identity services, applications, or user populations from legacy platforms to modern IAM architectures.

 

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.

description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About The Role

We're pioneering a new role focused exclusively on quality assurance for GenAI/Agentic systems. As our QA Automation Engineer within AI, you'll develop testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, and quality metrics specifically designed for LLM-powered applications. This role requires a unique blend of QA expertise, understanding of GenAI behaviour, and automation skills to ensure our AI features are reliable, accurate, and trustworthy.

Your Impact

  • Develop and execute end-to-end automated test coverage across evaluations, APIs, UIs, and performance tests using Python.
  • Implement testing strategies for GenAI features, including conversational AI, agentic systems, and LLM-powered workflows within your workstream.
  • Run and maintain automated test suites for prompt testing, including regression tests designed to detect unintended changes in model behaviour.
  • Support and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure GenAI performance across accuracy, relevance, safety, consistency, and latency.
  • Contribute to curating high-quality test datasets and "golden examples" that represent diverse user scenarios and edge cases.
  • Assist in adversarial testing to identify potential model hallucinations or biases, and support the integration of production alerting systems.
  • Utilise internal tools and testing frameworks to help developers easily validate their GenAI code, and assist with user acceptance testing.
  • Take accountability for your workstream's automated coverage, documenting testing procedures and known issues in clear, accessible formats.

Your Skills

  • Solid QA or test engineering experience, with exposure to or a keen interest in AI/ML systems.
  • Hands-on Python coding experience.
  • Good understanding of GenAI technologies including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application patterns.
  • Solid experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (Python, Pytest, API, and UI Testing).
  • Practical knowledge of software testing methodologies (functional, integration, regression, performance, security testing).
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured) and backend testing.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

Technical Documentation: You create and maintain the Technical Documentation according to MDR (DHF/DMR) for our three medical devices – one app listed in the DiGA directory and two CE-marked products in DiGA studies. Audits: You prepare and follow up on external audits with the notified body, and plan and conduct internal audits. Your first milestone: the ISO 13485 recertification audit in February 2027 – with a stable system, complete documentation, and a planned handover by your predecessor. Releases & Post-Market Surveillance: You review and approve release documentation and are responsible for post-market surveillance of our products. Supplier Management: You evaluate and monitor our software providers (e.g. Atlassian, HubSpot, Google) according to criticality. Regulatory Radar: You evaluate regulatory changes monthly and derive concrete measures. Interface within the Company: You are the primary contact for regulatory questions across all departments – from Doctor Success to Patient Success –, train colleagues, and proactively gather input. Whether the role of PRRC (Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance) becomes part of the function will be discussed together during the selection process – depending on your qualification and a clear agreement on responsibilities. The biggest challenge? Making regulatory requirements understandable across the company – explaining why something is necessary rather than just distributing guidelines – and actively engaging colleagues both in the office and remotely. What you should bring You have at least three years of relevant experience in the medical device field and know MDR and ISO 13485 from practical experience. You want to bring your QM/RA experience into a dedicated QMB role – or already bring it with you. You have prepared, accompanied, and followed up on audits. Having independently managed an audit is a plus – as is experience with internal audits. You bring genuine technical understanding: You know how software development works (frontend vs. backend, releases, tickets) without needing to code yourself. A background in hardware or implants is welcome if your tech affinity is right. You are ready to assume the QMB role according to ISO 13485. You work in a structured, thorough, and independent manner, actively approach colleagues, and follow up when input is missing. You can say "No, that won't work" – while simultaneously finding pragmatic, risk-based solutions that Engineering and Product can work with. You have very good German skills (at least C1) to reliably understand and communicate German DiGA regulations, and very good English skills for collaborating with our engineering team. A plus, but not a requirement: Experience with DiGA or Digital Health, SaMD (Software as a Medical Device), ISO 27001 / ISMS or BSI certifications, as well as knowledge of Confluence, Jira, or Matrix Requirements. What to expect at Vivira Ownership: You independently design the QMS – your own processes, high freedom, short decision-making paths. Career Leap: Your own QMB responsibility covering a broad spectrum including MDR, DiGA, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, and BSI – built on an established system with a planned handover. Workplace: Hybrid in Berlin with 1–2 days per week in the office. Travel occurs only occasionally (under 10%). Working Abroad: Up to one month per year, you can work from within the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Israel, or the UK. Recharge: 30 vacation days for true breaks. Health: Our app for your own back health. Securing the Future: Increased employer contribution to the company pension scheme. Corporate Benefits: Exclusive benefits for shopping, tech, and more. Referral Bonus: Every successful recommendation from your network is rewarded. Highlights: Multiple company and team events per year – and a dedicated team. Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

As a Senior Consultant (Account Director) in the Burson Tech PR team you will be heading up business technology accounts for some of the biggest businesses in this space. We are looking for someone with deep knowledge of B2B technology comms, with an understanding of the B2C landscape also, who can lead a team to deliver outstanding work for clients who are the industry leaders in this space. You’ll be someone who thrives in fast paced environments and experienced in working with globally recognised businesses who lead their fields and expect their communications to as well.  

We treat our Senior Consultants as both client and business leaders, expecting strong client counsel, energetic and committed team leadership, ambition to create award-winning work, and a consistent commitment to day-to-day excellence. 

What you'll do:

  • Trusted client counsel: Serve as the trusted senior point of contact for clients, providing strategic counsel and developing a comprehensive understanding of client objectives and industry.

  • Day to day leader & Quality control: Direct overall account activity, ensuring seamless execution, brilliant delivery, and consistently high levels of client service.
  • Team leader: Provide clear direction, motivate, and foster the professional growth of your team members, embodying strong leadership qualities.
  • Proactivity: Drive innovative execution for day-to-day press office work and campaigns
  • Confident problem solver: Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills, confidently challenging senior members and/or clients in pursuit of strategic integrity.
  • Team player: Play an active and helpful part in client teams and broader Burson initiatives, demonstrating effective time management and acting as an agency ambassador
  • Media Knowledge: You’ll have a nose for news and know how to develop excellent and insightful media strategies.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Established B2B Tech Senior Manager or Account Director experience, with broad expertise across areas such as Enterprise Tech, Cyber Tech or Fintech preferred.
  • A strong understanding of how to build and deliver effective media strategies for the new media era.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of media tech and enterprise technology with a 'nose for news'.
  • A robust network of relevant media contacts.
  • Proven ability to manage fast-paced, ambitious clients and dynamic portfolios, providing exceptional client counsel.
  • Energetic and committed team leadership experience, capable of inspiring and motivating teams.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills, coupled with a commitment to day-to-day excellence
